name: Filson Dry Roll-Top Tote Bag Green

The Dry Roll-Top Tote Bag–combining the versatile convenience that’s the hallmark of Filson totes with state-of-the-art waterproof protection. *Please note the Dry Bags have a 84OD TPU coating and will fade in direct sunlight.
